title: Men in black at Point Pleasant during Keel's Mothman investigation

tellings.quote: there were also men in black who would all of a sudden like show up outside the uh journalism bureau there

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells a story from Point Pleasant in 1966 and 1967, when the writer John Keel was looking into sightings of a winged creature people called Mothman. Jorjani says that strange men in black would suddenly turn up outside the local newspaper office there. If true, someone was quietly watching the people who were looking into the sightings.
